summary: Iteration 2: backend + frontend E2E validation of Soul Threading Smart AI IMG2Garment Mapper. Backend pytest suite extended (24 tests) — 100% pass on public URL (https://garment-ai-map.preview.emergentagent.com). Frontend loads with all six panels + AI Model Manager. Full end-to-end pipeline (upload → analyze → select garment → map → composed panels + quality gauge + guides tab + download ZIP) works when driven through the DOM. However, a critical UI/UX issue was found: the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlays the ActionBar buttons (btn-map + btn-download) in the bottom-right corner, intercepting real mouse clicks. Programmatic (JS) clicks work; real user clicks land on the badge anchor. This will make the app effectively unusable via mouse until the ActionBar is repositioned or given higher z-index.

minor.issue: composed_panels is a LIST of panel keys (not a dict). Currently works with frontend (which iterates over the list). Consumers should be aware.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Made with Emergent' branding badge (<a> element) overlays btn-map and btn-download at bottom-right of the viewport. document.elementFromPoint at the center of [data-testid="btn-map"] returns <A> (the badge) instead of <button>. Real mouse clicks are captured by the badge and never fire the map/download actions. Programmatic .click() bypasses this and confirms both buttons work perfectly.

issues: Bottom of the tile list is clipped by the ActionBar footer — some tiles cut off at ~y=515 (e.g. Oversized Hoodie tile only partly visible without scrolling); consider padding-bottom on scrollable grid to avoid overlap.
Uses `job.product_name` but the API returns `product_id`; check that `product_name` exists on job response — otherwise subtitle shows undefined.

action_items: CRITICAL: Prevent the 'Made with Emergent' badge from overlapping the ActionBar buttons. Options: (a) add right-padding/margin to ActionBar so buttons sit left of the badge, (b) raise the ActionBar's z-index above the badge, or (c) move btn-map / btn-download away from bottom-right corner. Without this fix, the Run Mapping and Download ZIP buttons are non-functional for real users.
Add bottom padding to Panel 03 GarmentGrid scroll container so tiles are not clipped by the ActionBar.

Verify `job.product_name` exists on /api/map response (frontend reads it in MasterPreview subtitle) — the payload returned by backend contains `product_id`; add `product_name` from garment_db to keep subtitle populated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_prune_jobs()` only runs on POST /api/map — JOB_STORE and ARTWORK_STORE can grow unbounded via other flows. Add LRU/max-size cap.
vision_smart_hint failure is swallowed as {'error': str(e)} with no logger.warning — add observability.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers.
/api/upload-artwork accepts any bytes as long as magic header sniffs match (or content_type is valid). Consider PIL.Image.verify() after storing to reject truncated/corrupt files.
Frontend usePolledFetch's name is misleading — it fetches once on mount (no polling). Rename or actually poll if that was the intent (model-status can change over time).
MasterPreview passes `panels` (list of strings) to renderers — works, but subtitle references `job.product_name` which is not part of API response. Guard against undefined or add the field.
Frontend upload panel's error handling only shows detail, but on non-4xx errors it fails silently — add generic fallback text.

success_rate.frontend: Functional flow: 100% (via JS click). Real-user-clickability: FAILS due to badge overlay on ActionBar buttons

seed_data_creation: Synthetic portrait & scene JPEGs generated in tests via PIL — no persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is deterministic, ~34s with pytest-xdist. Added TestAdditionalGarments class covering cargo_loose_shorts_design_template (back-only) and blade_collar_polo_shirt_design_template. Frontend E2E was verified by dispatching JS clicks on btn-map and garment tiles — real Playwright hover-and-click on btn-map fails because of the Emergent branding badge iframe/anchor overlaying it. When retesting after fix, use normal `page.click([data-testid="btn-map"])` (no force=True) — if fixed, it should succeed. LLM smart_hint is exhausted; pipeline gracefully falls back (analysis.smart_hint field contains {error: ...}).
rca of the issue: Root cause of critical frontend UI bug: the ActionBar footer places `btn-map` (Run Mapping) and `btn-download` (Download ZIP) in the bottom-right corner of the viewport at approximately x=1763-1903, y=1036-1072. The Emergent preview environment injects a persistent 'Made with Emergent' branding anchor tag at x=1762-1888, y=1034-1054 — directly overlapping the buttons. When a real user (or Playwright with default mouse-click actionability) clicks that region, hit-testing (document.elementFromPoint) returns the <A> badge, which either opens an external link or absorbs the click. The buttons never receive the pointerdown/click events. Reproduction: 1) Open app, upload artwork, run analyze, select garment. 2) Click 'run mapping' button with a real mouse — nothing happens; no /api/map network call fires. 3) Confirm via devtools: `document.elementFromPoint(btnRect.left+btnRect.width/2, btnRect.top+btnRect.height/2)` returns the branding <a>. Mitigation options for main agent: (a) add `padding-right: 160px` to ActionBar or wrap buttons in a container with `margin-right: 160px` to sit left of the badge; (b) set ActionBar CSS `z-index: 100` (badge appears to be z-index ~50); (c) relocate the primary actions to a floating button in the top-right or in the panel bodies instead of the corner. Any of these will restore clickability. Same fix also improves the GarmentGrid clipping.
